qualifications: Current1700 evaluation ran on CPU; previous1000 and priorcontrol evaluations ran on CUDA. Checkpoint fold/stream parity bounds exist, but this was not a paired CPU/GPU metric rerun.
Optimal scalar gain is computed analytically from uncentered cosine and RMS, no output audio was altered. A negative least-squares gain is clipped at0 for the nonnegative-gain summary.
Scalar gain optimization gives an upper bound on what per-clip gain correction could achieve in waveform MSE. It does not increase cosine or reconstruct missing phase/content.
